smooth_cost.barrier: Bregman of -log cos with even C4 Taylor continuation beyond 82 deg

model.synchrony_event: max raw MATPOWER-branch |angle difference| >= 90 deg; recorded separately, not added to J

noise_models.activity_scaled: a_i=|p_pre_i|; raw Gamma_i=0.25+min(a_i/q75(a),4); RMS-normalize over all 118 buses

H2.definition: uniform generator mode plus the first two nonconstant/soft eigenmodes of the post-event Kron-reduced generator stiffness
H2.selection_rule: smallest scanned rank whose tuned two-noise LQR cost is within one Monte-Carlo standard error of rank-10; safety crossing is secondary, not the optimization objective
H2.selection_reason: ranks 3,5,10 were statistically unresolved at training resolution; choose rank 3 as the parsimonious representative

H3.definition: independent actuation at all generator buses

controllers.static: fixed post-event equal generator balancing only; no transient feedback

saturation.convention: no command clipping in Stage 3A/3B baseline comparison unless a later robustness experiment explicitly adds it

training.objective: equal-weight average of smooth operational J at sigma_rms=0.15 over homogeneous and activity-scaled noise; crossing probability tracked separately

focused_confirmation.note: used to select scalar gains and H2 rank

freeze_check.note: fresh Stage-3A-only confirmation of already selected configurations

training.stage3B_rule: Stage 3B must use fresh common-random-number evaluation seeds disjoint from all_used_training_seeds; no Stage 3B evaluation has been run here.
